column3: Does the plain girl know? That you're dating...
I'm asking if Mana-chan knows about this!
Mana-chan. Isn't that what Kirino used to call Manami when we were kids?
Does she even remember that? Or did she unconsciously call her that?
Yeah. Not only that, we have her support.
It's not a lie. And why bring up Manami? She's got nothing to do with this.
She has! She definitely has! Because...
Why would Ayase... Yes, it's me.
Kirino took the phone and placed it to her ear.
Wait, how did that happen? Is this a joke?
I can't even begin to imagine what Manami and Kirino are talking about.
How soft-hearted can you be? I can't believe this...
Fine, do what you want, idiot! You're always getting in the way! I hate you!
She actually threw the phone right in my face!
What exactly did you tell Kirino?
I'll always be on your side, Kyou-chan.
...If she were in my shoes, would I say the same to her?
She's the best childhood friend you could ask for. That's always been true, and it'll stay that way.
While I wasn't looking, Kirino and Ayase has locked in a close confrontation.
Shut up. Don't talk to me.
You two just can't become lovers!
I just don't want you getting close to some weird guy, that's why.
Don't lie! Why are you still telling lies?!
You... You just don't want me to take Onii-san away from you, isn't that right?
No! Don't say such stupid things!
No... No no no no! It's not like that! I... I...
I hate my brother! I hate him! I totally hate him!!
But he's still my brother! Finally... I finally got back on speaking terms with him. I... I won't hand him over to anyone ever again!
That's how I feel! Got a problem with that?!
I was just thinking, if you'd gotten a boyfriend, I would probably say something similar... I guess.
Considering the situation, let me be frank. I hate you. I've always hated you.
But... You are my sister. My sister, with whom I've finally gotten back on speaking terms with.
That's why I'd rather die than let some man take you away. Just thinking of it makes me want to kill the man.
That's how you really feel, isn't it?
I think I know what you're going to say, but I'll listen.
Onii-san... You prioritize Kirino over me?
G-Going along with your sister's selfishness... and breaking up with your lover?
You really are a hopeless siscon. But that's just like you, Onii-san.
There's no need to apologize. I can't ignore Kirino just to go out with Onii-san either.
Don't say what you were about to say.
And... Please don't misunderstand, you two.
I haven't... given up on Onii-san.
H-Huh?! What are you saying?! You're making it sound like I--
Haha... If you get that flustered, you're going to make people misunderstand.
Other than that, Ayase had nothing more to say.
Tomorrow, Ayase would, as Kirino's friend, come over to our house to visit, acting as if nothing ever happened.
I would welcome her into the house with a straight face.
All the while bearing this pain in my heart.
I really am a hopeless siscon.
Looking at my sister's sincerely apologetic face.
My little sister can't be this cute.
